text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Tap Dance City stacked achievement upon achievement at home—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That moment" had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go! Let's do this, you guys!
Finally! Finally, finally!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Time to set off for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying them were the usual four plus the core staff members.
On top of that, there were club members who had volunteered to join.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City's crew had grown so large that they could organize an expedition on this scale.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This feels great!
Visibility is clear, schedule has plenty of room.
Not a single thing to worry about."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The opponent was strong, yet our preparation was complete.
Without a shred of doubt, we were meant to claim this triumph.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Airport Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Attention, please.
Attention, please.
An announcement for all guests.

text_block_list.name: Airport Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Flight 238 from Narita to Paris has been
suddenly cancelled due to an aircraft malfunction.

text_block_list.name: Airport Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, alternative flights are currently undecided.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Two-three-eight...
Flight 238...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What!?
Isn't that the flight we're supposed to be on?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, due to the troubles, our departure was postponed.
On short notice, we were left departing just two days
before the race—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Get out of the way! Just let me through!
I'm gonna be late for the race, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Entering the paddock already?!
I've barely even had a proper warm-up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Aaagh, whatever, come what may--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, amid all the chaos, Tap Dance City ran her absolute best, but...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Tap Dance City crosses the line in 17th!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "She gave it her all from a good position, but she completely ran out of steam on the final stretch."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
How could this even happen...
Is this for real...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Enduring and enduring, building up strength, and finally
a challenge at the perfect moment. That is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"After scrambling arouuund like that,
I ended up in 17th plaaace?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her anger was completely justified.
If this was fate, it was simply far too cruel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If everything I've built up until now was just to be crushed by misfortune, then...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Kuh..., heh...
Heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! What the heck is this?!
Are you mocking me? Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is the absolute best!
A-hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City suddenly burst into laughter.
She went on laughing for quite some time, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Argh, it's a loss, a total loss! I was just spinning my wheels to an embarrassing degree.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this loss, everything's down the drain!
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a single day, I lost everything.
Far from landing a major sponsor,
I had merely thrown the expedition funds straight into the Seine.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You guys are cracking up too, right?
I mean, how could something like this even happen?"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text: Right~? It's so terrible it might even give me nightmares~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
There's a limit to how bad one's luck can be.
I'm past the point of lamenting...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: "It's pretty funny, honestly. Especially since this is my first time traveling abroad in my entire life."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
When I get back, I'm gonna brag to everyone!
About what an absolute disaster it was, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Tap and the 4 Others
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tap and the 4 Others
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, ahahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, a wave of wry chuckles spreads among her friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through laughter and tears, they were truly one and the same, to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine.
It certainly was a terrible expedition, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Because every last one of us got to taste
just how terrible it was!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This is the real treasure.
Alright you guys, let's start over from scratch!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: As long as our friendship remains, that's what counts, right!?

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Back to square one again. But no matter how many times they fail,
Tap Dance City and the others never hang their heads."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding hands and locking shoulders—
they sailed on, together forever.
